verification_instructions: 1. Run `flutter analyze` from repo root — expect zero errors. 2. Run `flutter test test/ipo_logic_test.dart` — all tests must pass. Do NOT build AAB.
environment_constraints: Do NOT build AAB. Do NOT touch: KAP Haberleri, Borsa Haberleri, Trial, Premium, Billing, AI, UpdateService, back button systems. Do NOT add new data fields to IpoItem — use only existing fields.
contribution_requirements: Work in the main worktree at the absolute path below. All commits stay local, never push.
key_patterns: IpoItem.status getter calls _deriveStatus() on every access when _hasTimelineData==true. _groupedItems() in ipo_screen.dart filters and sorts _items into 4 groups. The _IpoGroups class holds: upcoming, collecting, pendingListing, trading (all), latestTrading (trading.take(10)). Summary chips use grouped.X.length. Tab body uses grouped.latestTrading for Borsada tab.
directory_structure: lib/models/ — data models; lib/screens/ — UI screens; lib/services/ — business logic / data fetching; test/ — flutter_test tests; tools/ — Node.js scraper; data/ — ipo_feed.json (gitignored runtime data); assets/data/ — ipo_seed.json (bundled seed data)
